items.prompt: One single continuous shot from behind on a narrow dirt path up to a hillside vegetable field in early spring in Hokkaido: an elderly Japanese man in a beige work jacket walks slowly uphill holding up a small portable radio in one hand and a red packet of firecrackers in the other, pauses, turns his head warily toward the wooded hill, then keeps climbing. His face is never visible. No cuts, no scene change. No snow anywhere. 8 seconds. Photorealistic, shot on RED camera. Documentary style.
